title: Kotton culture. Kotton white.
text: Kotton culture. Kotton white.. This sheet set by Kotton Culture are decent. They are 100% Egyptian Cotton, 600 thread count, stark white sheets with deep pockets. They fit my king size bed well. The only thing I noticed was that when I washed them, prior to placing them on my bed, they wrinkle a lot. I had to iron them before placing them on my bed. That was a little inconvenient. But otherwise, these sheets do make for a nice, peaceful sleep.
